description: This source file defines the TypeConverter class used for formatting and parsing Type instances within the Orleans.Serialization.TypeSystem namespace. It includes methods for converting types to string representations, parsing strings into Type objects, and handling type filtering and aliasing based on configuration.

classes.name: TypeConverter
classes.description: A class responsible for converting Type instances to string representations and parsing strings back into Type objects, with support for type filtering, aliasing, and configuration-based rules.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a Type into its string representation, optionally allowing rewriting via a rewriter delegate.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a Type object, throwing an exception if parsing or resolution fails.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a Type object, returning a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: FormatInternal
methods.description: Internal method that performs the formatting of a Type, applying converters and rewriting as needed.

methods.name: ParseInternal
methods.description: Internal method that parses a string or a parsed TypeSpec into a Type object.

methods.name: IsNameTypeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a given QualifiedType is allowed based on configuration and filters.

methods.name: ConvertToDisplayName
methods.description: Converts a QualifiedType to its display name alias if applicable.

methods.name: ConvertFromDisplayName
methods.description: Converts a display name alias back to its runtime QualifiedType.

methods.name: UpdateValidationResult
methods.description: Updates the validation result state based on whether a type name is allowed.

methods.name: InspectType
methods.description: Recursively inspects a Type against filters to determine if it is allowed.

methods.name: ResolveCompoundAliasType
methods.description: Resolves a compound type alias into a TypeSpec, parsing and resolving nested types.
